title: Radio Emergency Updates
description: Explains how Wireless Emergency Alerts, the Emergency Alert System, and NOAA Weather Radio reach you, how to program SAME county codes, and what alert terms and tones mean. Covers choosing a radio, saving batteries, scanners and shortwave, and FRS/GMRS rules, including why privacy codes don't make calls private.
shortDescription: WEA, EAS, NOAA Weather Radio with SAME, alert tones, and FRS/GMRS basics
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
